newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish mid-Nov CPI up 1.9 pct yr/yr - CSO.
newsitem.headline: Irish mid-Nov CPI up 1.9 pct yr/yr - CSO.

text.p: Irish inflation, as measured by the quarterly consumer price index, rose 1.9 percent in the year to mid-November compared with a 1.5 percent rise in the year to mid-August, the Central Statistics Office (CSO) said on Thursday.
Market forecasts for annual growth in the quarterly CPI had ranged from 1.7 to 1.9 percent.
The annual average rise in the CPI in 1996 was 1.6 percent, the CSO said.
The European Union interim index of consumer prices, which is used for intra-EU comparisons, showed a 0.5 percent rise over the quarter for an annual rise of 2.3 percent.
The consumer price index excluding mortgage interest rose 0.4 percent over the quarter and 2.0 percent year-on-year.
